It was a beautiful clear night, with a nice solid freeze. McKay Loop is Groomed and track set, but only from the Summit Access down to the Cattle Grid, the northeast side is clear of snow from about halfway up. Pretty Valley Road from Eagle Rock to the Stockyards is groomed and track set, I spent some time repairing some of the thinner sections along the top last night, The patchy spots at the very bottom near the Stockyards are getting worse. Pretty Valley Road from Eagle Rock down to Panorama Loop is very patchy and ungroomed. Panorama Loop is partially groomed and track set, from AGL corner to just before the Observation Deck. High Plains Road is fairly poor, from the Aqueduct to the turn off for AGL corner. Lower Horseyard Loop is partially groomed and set from the Nordic Bowl.. Aqueduct from High Plains Road is groomed for about 100 mtrs into the Nordic Bowl. The Nordic Bowl is Partially groomed and track set, today could possibly be the last day for the Nordic Bowl, depending on how warm it gets today. The inner trails were the last to be groomed, meaning they will be slightly softer first thing. The track setting is a bit average as I had to keep lifting the tiller to repair damage to the trails. Have a great day!
